title: Closed-support triangle before restriction
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion of schemes, with complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow T$, and let $A$ be a finite ring, not necessarily commutative. For $S=T,U,Z$, let $A_S$ be the sheafification of the constant presheaf of rings with value $A$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and write $D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_S))$ for the ordinary unbounded derived category of sheaves of left $A_S$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. The direct image $i_*$ is taken termwise on these derived categories, and $Ri^!$ denotes its right adjoint [lem-exc-closed-ambient]. Let $j^*$ be open restriction (inverse image) and $Rj_*$ the total unbounded right derived functor of direct image. Then for every $K\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ there is a natural distinguished triangle [def-weil-triangulated-category]
$$i_*Ri^!K\longrightarrow K\longrightarrow Rj_*j^*K\longrightarrow (i_*Ri^!K)[1],$$
whose first two maps are respectively the counit of $i_*\dashv Ri^!$ and the unit of $j^*\dashv Rj_*$. No constructibility is assumed of the values of this right adjoint.

proof.text: Use the supplied closed adjunction Ri_* left adjoint to its chosen rightAdjoint. Closed and open underived direct images are fully faithful for arbitrary coefficients. They preserve K-injective complexes as right adjoints to exact inverse images; their total right derived functors are therefore fully faithful. This uses only Ring A, with no monoidal or commutative structure.
Write F=Ri_*, G=Rj_* and J=D(j^*). Disjointness gives J(FM)=0. Since J commutes with shifts, adjunction gives Hom((FM)[n],GN)=Hom(J((FM)[n]),N)=0 for every n.

If JE=0, the unit E to Ri_*D(i^*)E is inverted by J, because both source and target vanish. It is inverted by D(i^*) as well: the counit is invertible by full faithfulness and the triangle identity identifies the restricted unit with its inverse. Derived open-closed conservativity therefore makes the unit invertible. Thus E lies in the essential image of F.

Complete the open unit K to GJK to a distinguished triangle Kprime to K to GJK. Since G is fully faithful, the counit JG to 1 is invertible, so J inverts the unit by the triangle identity. Exactness of J makes JKprime zero. Step 3 puts Kprime in the image of F. Apply the orthogonal counit-triangle theorem using Step 2: the prescribed closed counit and open unit extend to a distinguished triangle.

Choose a boundary for each K. For f:K to Kprime, the counit naturality and the zero composite of adjacent distinguished-triangle maps give the hypothesis of triangle-morphism extension with middle component f. Shift-one orthogonality makes the first and third components uniquely determined by their adjacent squares, so they are precisely Ri_*Ri^!(f) and Rj_*j^*(f). The last square is boundary naturality. Assemble these boundaries into the natural transformation delta; its pointwise distinguishedness is Step 4. The choices occur only in a theorem, not in data chosen from an unproved existence theorem.

proof_origin.place: Shorter formal route: derived vanishing and conservativity, full right-derived direct images, orthogonal counit completion and triangle-morphism naturality. The unit route is unchanged; no ordinary monoidal open-closed triangle or exceptional lower shriek is used.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q54-4cce5901b (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and all 12 steps in full, along with the full statement of every cited node, the unit sk-prop-sf-existence and the chapter. The blueprint is identical in master, main-20261015 and main-20261017. I also read Stacks 0A45 (etale-cohomology l.14072), 093X (sites-cohomology l.1962) and 08FI (l.4314). The statement is the blueprint's, made precise without weakening: finite A, possibly noncommutative, with left A_S-modules in unbounded D(Mod(A_S)), the same coefficient category as lem-exc-closed-ambient. The first two arrows are named as the counit and unit. I tested Z empty, Z=T, K=0, A=0 and M_2(F_2). Step checks: in Step 2 the site and topology identification and the ring isomorphism e_P apply to arbitrary rings. In Step 4 forgetting scalars is faithful and exact, and the step proves it reflects exactness. In Step 5, lem-pur-kinjective-restrict-localized covers any sheaf of rings: its statement and Lean record use RingCat, and the commutative wording in def-pur-kinjective-complex is incidental. In Step 6, 04CA's scheme conventions impose no Noetherian hypothesis. Step 8 is the 093X free-module proof. I checked the Yoneda identity x|_{ac}=(x|_a)|_c. The existing abelian-sheaf node lem-weil-pbc-injective-sheaf-mono-restriction would not suffice, because an injective A_T-module need not be an injective abelian sheaf. Step 10 has the adjunction the right way round (u=H, v=i_* exact) and identifies RH with Ri^! by uniqueness of adjoints. Step 12 shows the boundary map depends only on homotopy classes, so the triangle is natural on all of D(T). There are no new nodes and no cycle among the 197 reachable nodes, and proof_deps equals the union of the steps' uses. I found no duplicates: the closest candidates are all pro-étale/condensed or state other results. All 14 off-route statements are declared, and I accept the 3 new tool uses (site-sheafification-sections-local, site-restriction-exact, module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful) as generic black-box tools. lean.statement: theorem exists_etale_closedSupportTriangle (A : Type (u + 1)) [Ring A] [Finite A] {Z T U : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i] (j : U ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion j] (hij : Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ) : ∃ δ : D(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j) ⋙ R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j) ⟶ ((R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i)).rightAdjoint ⋙ R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i)) ⋙ shiftFunctor (_root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) (1 : ℤ), ∀ K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)), Triangle.mk ((Adjunction.ofIsLeftAdjoint (R(lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i))).counit.app K) ((mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).unit.app K) (δ.app K) ∈ distTriang _
lean.note: Uses the ordinary unbounded derived category of module-valued etale sheaves, as in lem-exc-closed-ambient. The existential boundary is a natural transformation; the first two arrows are the specified canonical adjunction counit and unit. No commutativity, constructibility or boundedness hypothesis.
